FBH-01-001-left_out.id: Hampir! Teman baru sering merasa malu. Kalau dibiarkan, ia makin sendirian. {model}
FBH-01-001-left_out.en: Almost! New classmates often feel shy. Left alone, they feel even lonelier. {model}

FBH-01-001-interrupt.id: Hampir! Memotong saat ia bicara membuatnya enggan bercerita. {model}
FBH-01-001-interrupt.en: Almost! Cutting in while they talk makes them less willing to speak. {model}

FBH-01-003-b.id: Hampir! Kata "aneh" bisa membuat teman malu. Makanan itu istimewa baginya. {model}
FBH-01-003-b.en: Almost! "Weird" can make a friend feel embarrassed. That food is special to them. {model}

FBH-01-003-c.id: Hampir! Ditertawakan itu menyakitkan. Lebih seru kalau saling mengenal. {model}
FBH-01-003-c.en: Almost! Being laughed at hurts. Getting to know each other is more fun. {model}

FBH-01-009-b.id: Hampir! Sampahnya banyak, tapi banyak tangan yang membantu. {model}
FBH-01-009-b.en: Almost! There was a lot of rubbish, but many hands helped. {model}

FBH-01-009-c.id: Hampir! Ingat, tua dan muda ikut bekerja. {model}
FBH-01-009-c.en: Almost! Remember, young and old all joined in. {model}

FBH-01-010-walk.id: Hampir! Kalau kita lewat saja, ia harus memungut sendirian. {model}
FBH-01-010-walk.en: Almost! If we just walk past, they have to pick them all up alone. {model}

FBH-01-010-read.id: Hampir! Membaca bisa nanti. Bantuan dibutuhkan sekarang. {model}
FBH-01-010-read.en: Almost! Reading can wait. Help is needed now. {model}

FBH-01-013-b.id: Hampir! Itu membuatnya makin sedih. Warna kulit tidak menentukan siapa teman yang baik. {model}
FBH-01-013-b.en: Almost! That makes them even sadder. Skin colour doesn't decide who's a good friend. {model}

FBH-01-013-c.id: Hampir! Diam tidak menolongnya. Ajakan kecil darimu bisa sangat berarti. {model}
FBH-01-013-c.en: Almost! Staying quiet doesn't help them. A small invitation from you can mean a lot. {model}

FBH-01-014-run.id: Hampir! Kalau kita lari saja, nenek tetap kesulitan. {model}
FBH-01-014-run.en: Almost! If we run off, she still struggles. {model}

FBH-01-014-phone.id: Hampir! Ponsel bisa nanti. Nenek butuh bantuan sekarang. {model}
FBH-01-014-phone.en: Almost! The phone can wait. She needs help now. {model}

FBH-02-001-bag.id: Hampir! Kalau dimasukkan ke tasmu, temanmu bisa kebingungan mencarinya. {model}
FBH-02-001-bag.en: Almost! If it goes into your bag, your friend may be left searching for it. {model}

FBH-02-001-go_home.id: Hampir! Pulang tanpa mengembalikan membuat temanmu menunggu. {model}
FBH-02-001-go_home.en: Almost! Going home without returning it leaves your friend waiting. {model}

FBH-02-003-b.id: Hampir! Besok pagi waktunya sempit, kamu bisa terburu-buru. {model}
FBH-02-003-b.en: Almost! Tomorrow morning is short, and you might rush it. {model}

FBH-02-003-c.id: Hampir! PR itu latihan untukmu. Kalau dikerjakan orang lain, kamu tidak belajar. {model}
FBH-02-003-c.en: Almost! Homework is practice for you. If someone else does it, you don't learn. {model}

FBH-02-006-b.id: Hampir! Temanmu akan kaget dan sedih. Lebih baik ia tahu darimu. {model}
FBH-02-006-b.en: Almost! Your friend will be surprised and sad. It's better they hear it from you. {model}

FBH-02-006-c.id: Hampir! Itu tidak jujur. Kepercayaan lebih penting daripada mainan. {model}
FBH-02-006-c.en: Almost! That isn't honest. Trust matters more than a toy. {model}

FBH-02-008-b.id: Hampir! Di cerita, ia ingat sendiri tanpa ditagih. {model}
FBH-02-008-b.en: Almost! In the story, they remembered without being asked. {model}

FBH-02-008-c.id: Hampir! Minta maaf itu baik, tapi di cerita janjinya berhasil ditepati. {model}
FBH-02-008-c.en: Almost! Saying sorry is good, but in the story the promise was kept. {model}

FBH-02-009-late.id: Hampir! Di cerita, ia berangkat tepat waktu. {model}
FBH-02-009-late.en: Almost! In the story, they set off on time. {model}

FBH-02-009-copy_answer.id: Hampir! Itu bukan bagian dari cerita. Coba ingat buku yang dipinjam. {model}
FBH-02-009-copy_answer.en: Almost! That wasn't in the story. Think about the borrowed book. {model}

FBH-02-013-play.id: Hampir! Main boleh setelah piket selesai. Teman-teman mengandalkanmu. {model}
FBH-02-013-play.en: Almost! Play after your duty is done. Your classmates are counting on you. {model}

FBH-02-013-go_home.id: Hampir! Kalau pulang duluan, temanmu harus mengerjakan bagianmu. {model}
FBH-02-013-go_home.en: Almost! If you go home early, your friends have to do your part. {model}

FBH-02-014-b.id: Hampir! Temanmu bisa menunggu lama dan cemas. {model}
FBH-02-014-b.en: Almost! Your friend might wait a long time and worry. {model}

FBH-02-014-c.id: Hampir! Janji yang terlalu besar sulit ditepati. Pilih waktu yang pasti. {model}
FBH-02-014-c.en: Almost! A promise that big is hard to keep. Pick a time you're sure of. {model}

body.id: Teman kita bisa berbeda agama, suku, bahasa daerah, warna kulit, atau kemampuan.
body.en: Our friends can differ in religion, ethnic group, home language, skin colour or abilities.

body.id: Menghormati artinya tidak mengejek dan mau saling mengenal.
body.en: Respect means no teasing and wanting to get to know each other.

body.id: Gotong royong: banyak tangan membuat pekerjaan berat jadi ringan.
body.en: Gotong royong: many hands make heavy work light.

body.id: Tanggung jawab artinya menyelesaikan tugas kita dan merawat barang, termasuk barang pinjaman.
body.en: Responsibility means finishing our tasks and caring for things, including borrowed ones.

body.id: Menepati janji artinya melakukan apa yang sudah kita katakan, termasuk datang tepat waktu.
body.en: Keeping a promise means doing what we said, including being on time.

body.id: Kalau janji tidak bisa ditepati, beri tahu lebih awal dan minta maaf.
body.en: If you can't keep a promise, say so early and apologise.

ST-NIL-K-M-GOTONG.figure: Aya dan teman-teman (tokoh rekaan / fictional characters)
ST-NIL-K-M-GOTONG.source: Cerita asli AyaIlmu (fiksi) / AyaIlmu original story (fiction)

caption.id: Minggu pagi, para tetangga saling menyapa. Hari ini ada kerja bakti di kampung.
caption.en: On Sunday morning, the neighbours greet each other. Today is the kampung clean-up day.

caption.id: Warga datang membawa sapu, cangkul, dan ember. Semua ikut, tua dan muda.
caption.en: People bring brooms, hoes and buckets. Everyone joins in, young and old.

caption.id: Anak-anak mengangkut daun kering bersama. Yang berat diangkat berdua.
caption.en: The children carry dry leaves together. Heavy loads are lifted in pairs.

caption.id: Selesai bekerja, ada yang membawa pisang goreng dan teh untuk semua.
caption.en: When the work is done, someone brings fried bananas and tea for everyone.

caption.id: Kampung jadi bersih, dan warga makin akrab. Itulah gotong royong!
caption.en: The kampung is clean, and neighbours feel closer. That's gotong royong!

ST-NIL-K-M-JANJI.figure: Aya dan teman-teman (tokoh rekaan / fictional characters)
ST-NIL-K-M-JANJI.source: Cerita asli AyaIlmu (fiksi) / AyaIlmu original story (fiction)

caption.id: Sepulang sekolah, seorang anak meminjam buku cerita dari temannya. "Kukembalikan hari Senin!" janjinya.
caption.en: After school, a child borrows a storybook from a friend. "I'll bring it back on Monday!" they promise.

caption.id: Minggu malam, ia ingat janjinya. Buku itu langsung ia masukkan ke tas.
caption.en: On Sunday night, they remember the promise and put the book straight into their bag.

caption.id: Senin pagi, ia berangkat tepat waktu.
caption.en: On Monday morning, they set off on time.

caption.id: Buku kembali dalam keadaan baik. "Terima kasih sudah meminjamkan!"
caption.en: The book comes back in good shape. "Thanks for lending it to me!"

caption.id: Temannya tersenyum. Janji yang ditepati membuat orang percaya pada kita.
caption.en: The friend smiles. Keeping promises helps people trust us.

meaning.id: Teman baru bicara dengan logat yang berbeda.
meaning.en: A new classmate speaks with a different accent.

model_answer.id: Ajak ia bermain dan dengarkan ceritanya. Logatnya adalah bagian dari kekayaan daerah asalnya.
model_answer.en: Invite them to play and listen to their stories. Their accent is part of the richness of where they come from.

meaning.id: Baik atau kurang baik?
meaning.en: Good or not so good?

text.en: Playing with all kinds of friends
Shutting a friend out for being different
Inviting a new friend to play

model_answer.id: Baik: bermain bersama, mendengarkan, mengajak. Mengucilkan dan mengejek kurang baik, karena membuat teman merasa tidak diterima.
model_answer.en: Good: playing together, listening, inviting. Shutting out and teasing are not so good, because they make a friend feel unwelcome.

meaning.id: Teman membawa makanan khas daerahnya. Kamu belum pernah melihatnya.
meaning.en: A friend brings food from their home region. You've never seen it.

model_answer.id: Bertanya dengan sopan. Kamu bisa belajar hal baru, dan temanmu merasa dihargai.
model_answer.en: Ask politely. You learn something new, and your friend feels valued.

meaning.id: Kenali kekayaan budaya Indonesia.
meaning.en: Get to know Indonesia's cultures.

model_answer.id: Batik, gamelan, sasando dari Pulau Rote, dan tari Saman dari Aceh: berbeda-beda, semuanya milik Indonesia.
model_answer.en: Batik, gamelan, the sasando from Rote Island and the Saman dance from Aceh: all different, all Indonesia's.

meaning.id: Teman yang berbeda suku atau agama tetap bisa menjadi sahabat baik.
meaning.en: Friends from a different ethnic group or religion can still be best friends.

model_answer.id: Perbedaan membuat persahabatan makin kaya: kita bisa saling belajar.
model_answer.en: Differences make a friendship richer: we learn from each other.

meaning.id: Saat teman bercerita tentang kebiasaan keluarganya, aku ____ dengan sungguh-sungguh.
meaning.en: When a friend shares their family's customs, I ____ closely.

model_answer.id: Mendengarkan dengan sungguh-sungguh menunjukkan kita menghormati teman.
model_answer.en: Listening closely shows we respect our friend.

model_answer.id: Gotong royong: bekerja bersama sampai yang berat terasa ringan.
model_answer.en: Gotong royong: working together until heavy work feels light.

meaning.id: Apa yang terjadi saat kerja bakti?
meaning.en: What happened on clean-up day?

model_answer.id: Menyapa, bekerja bakti, mengangkut daun bersama, lalu makan dan minum bersama.
model_answer.en: Greeting, cleaning up, carrying leaves together, then eating and drinking together.

meaning.id: Kenapa pekerjaan di cerita cepat selesai?
meaning.en: Why was the work done so quickly?

text.id: Karena hanya orang dewasa yang bekerja

model_answer.id: Semua ikut membantu, jadi pekerjaan berat terasa ringan dan cepat selesai.
model_answer.en: Everyone helped, so the heavy work felt light and was soon done.

meaning.id: Teman sekelasmu menjatuhkan banyak buku.
meaning.en: A classmate drops a pile of books.

model_answer.id: Bantu memungut bukunya. Bersama, cepat selesai.
model_answer.en: Help pick up the books. Together it's quick.

meaning.id: Siapa butuh bantuan, dan bagaimana?
meaning.en: Who needs help, and how?

text.en: a friend who has a fever

model_answer.id: Nenek: bawakan belanjaannya. Teman sedih: temani dan dengarkan. Teman sakit: kirim ucapan cepat sembuh.
model_answer.en: Grandma: carry her shopping. A sad friend: stay and listen. A sick friend: send a get-well message.

meaning.id: Dalam gotong royong, semua orang harus mengerjakan tugas yang sama.
meaning.en: In gotong royong, everyone has to do exactly the same job.

model_answer.id: Setiap orang membantu sesuai kemampuannya: ada yang menyapu, mengangkut daun, atau membagikan minum.
model_answer.en: Everyone helps in the way they can: some sweep, some carry leaves, some hand out drinks.

meaning.id: Beberapa anak menjauhi teman karena warna kulitnya.
meaning.en: Some children avoid a classmate because of their skin colour.

text.en: Invite them to play with me

model_answer.id: Ajak dia bermain. Kalau ia terus dijauhi atau diejek, ceritakan kepada guru.
model_answer.en: Invite them to play. If it keeps happening, tell a teacher.

meaning.id: Seorang nenek ingin menyeberang jalan.
meaning.en: An old woman wants to cross the road.

model_answer.id: Tawarkan bantuan dan menyeberanglah bersama di zebra cross. Kalau jalannya ramai, minta tolong orang dewasa.
model_answer.en: Offer to help and cross together at the zebra crossing. If the road is busy, ask a grown-up to help.

items.source: Pidato Ir. Soekarno di sidang BPUPKI, 1 Juni 1945 ("Lahirnya Pancasila"), dalam Risalah Sidang Badan Penyelidik Usaha-usaha Persiapan Kemerdekaan Indonesia (BPUPKI) dan Panitia Persiapan Kemerdekaan Indonesia (PPKI), Sekretariat Negara RI, 1995; Keputusan Presiden RI No. 24 Tahun 2016 tentang Hari Lahir Pancasila.

model_answer.id: Pada 1 Juni 1945, Bung Karno berpidato tentang dasar negara Indonesia. Ia berkata, kalau lima sila diperas menjadi satu, hasilnya adalah "gotong royong".
model_answer.en: On 1 June 1945, Sukarno gave a speech about the foundations of the Indonesian state. He said that if the five principles were squeezed into one, the result would be "gotong royong".

meaning.id: Pensil pinjaman sudah selesai kamu pakai.
meaning.en: You've finished with a borrowed pencil.

model_answer.id: Kembalikan dan ucapkan terima kasih. Temanmu akan senang meminjamkan lagi.
model_answer.en: Give it back and say thank you. Your friend will be happy to lend again.

meaning.id: Mengerjakan PR sampai beres.
meaning.en: Getting homework done.

text.en: Put it in your bag for tomorrow
Work on it until it's done

model_answer.id: Catat, siapkan alat tulis, kerjakan sampai selesai, lalu masukkan ke tas.
model_answer.en: Write it down, get your things ready, finish it, then pack it in your bag.

meaning.id: Ada PR, tapi temanmu mengajak bermain.
meaning.en: You have homework, but a friend asks you to play.

text.id: Main dulu, PR besok pagi saja

text.en: Ask a friend to do it for me

model_answer.id: Selesaikan PR dulu. Setelah itu kamu bisa bermain dengan tenang.
model_answer.en: Finish your homework first. Then you can play with nothing on your mind.

meaning.id: Merawat hewan peliharaan termasuk tanggung jawab.
meaning.en: Looking after a pet is a responsibility.

model_answer.id: Hewan peliharaan bergantung pada kita untuk makan, minum, dan tempat yang bersih.
model_answer.en: Pets depend on us for food, water and a clean place to live.

meaning.id: Tugas apa untuk setiap gambar?
meaning.en: Which job goes with each picture?

model_answer.id: Kucing diberi makan dan minum, tanaman disiram, tempat tidur dirapikan, tas disiapkan untuk besok.
model_answer.en: Feed the cat, water the plants, make the bed, pack the bag for tomorrow.

meaning.id: Kamu tidak sengaja merusak mainan pinjaman.
meaning.en: You accidentally break a borrowed toy.

text.en: Give it back without a word

text.id: Bilang terus terang, minta maaf, tawarkan memperbaiki
text.en: Say so, apologise, offer to fix it

model_answer.id: Bilang terus terang, minta maaf, dan tawarkan untuk memperbaiki atau menggantinya bersama orang tuamu.
model_answer.en: Tell them honestly, say sorry and offer to fix or replace it with your parents' help.

model_answer.id: Janji yang ditepati membuat orang percaya pada kita.
model_answer.en: Keeping promises helps people trust us.

meaning.id: Apa yang membuat janjinya tertepati?
meaning.en: What helped them keep the promise?

text.en: They waited for their friend to ask
They packed the book the night before

model_answer.id: Ia menyiapkan buku sejak malam dan berangkat tepat waktu. Rencana kecil membantu menepati janji.
model_answer.en: They packed the book the night before and left on time. A little planning helps keep promises.

meaning.id: Apa yang terjadi di akhir cerita?
meaning.en: What happened at the end of the story?

model_answer.id: Buku dikembalikan dalam keadaan baik, tepat seperti yang dijanjikan.
model_answer.en: The book was returned in good shape, just as promised.

meaning.id: Janji mana yang bisa ditepati?
meaning.en: Which promises can be kept?

text.en: "I promise to water the plants this afternoon."

text.id: "Aku janji tidak akan pernah salah lagi."
text.en: "I promise I'll never make a mistake again."
"I promise to return your book tomorrow."

model_answer.id: Janji yang baik itu jelas dan bisa dilakukan: menyiram tanaman, mengembalikan buku, datang jam 4. Janji yang terlalu besar sulit ditepati, jadi lebih baik tidak diucapkan.
model_answer.en: Good promises are clear and doable: watering the plants, returning a book, coming at 4. Promises that are too big are hard to keep, so it's better not to make them.

meaning.id: Kalau janji tidak bisa ditepati.
meaning.en: When you can't keep a promise.

text.id: Minta maaf dan jelaskan alasannya dengan jujur
text.en: Say sorry and honestly explain why
Tell your friend as soon as you can

model_answer.id: Beri tahu secepatnya, minta maaf dan jelaskan dengan jujur, lalu tawarkan waktu lain.
model_answer.en: Tell them early, say sorry and explain honestly, then offer another time.

meaning.id: Datang terlambat tanpa kabar membuat teman menunggu dan cemas.
meaning.en: Arriving late without a word leaves a friend waiting and worried.

model_answer.id: Kalau akan terlambat, kabari lebih dulu supaya teman tidak cemas.
model_answer.en: If you'll be late, let them know first so they don't worry.

meaning.id: Hari ini giliranmu piket kelas.
meaning.en: It's your turn on class cleaning duty today.

model_answer.id: Kerjakan piketmu sampai selesai. Kelas yang bersih membuat semua nyaman.
model_answer.en: Do your duty until it's finished. A clean classroom is good for everyone.

meaning.id: Kamu janji main jam 4, tapi diajak orang tua ke pasar.
meaning.en: You promised to play at 4, but your parents need you at the market.

text.id: Diam saja, nanti temanku pulang sendiri
text.en: Say nothing, they'll go home eventually
Promise to play all day tomorrow

text.id: Kabari temanmu dan janjikan waktu lain
text.en: Tell your friend and set another time

model_answer.id: Kabari temanmu secepatnya, minta maaf, dan tawarkan waktu lain yang pasti.
model_answer.en: Let your friend know quickly, say sorry and offer another time you're sure of.

meaning.id: Aku dikerjakan banyak orang bersama-sama, sampai yang berat terasa ringan. Aku kebiasaan baik dari Indonesia. Siapa aku?
meaning.en: Lots of people do me together, until heavy work feels light. I'm a good Indonesian tradition. What am I?

model_answer.id: Gotong royong!
model_answer.en: Gotong royong!
